messages:
deploy-bot: initiating rollout rl-2026-03-23-22 canary=15% -> plan step to 45% in 12m
anya: heads-up — eu-west synth p95 for /chat/complete jumped to ~260ms from ~160ms, still 200s responses though :thinking:
sam: looking at gateway and auth proxy traces now
matt: correlating: auth header lookup QPS increased, auth-kv miss rate ~6% (baseline ~0.5%) on gw-prod-5
lucy: this deploy toggled routing.hint_local_first and bumped conn pool to reduce cross-az hops per release notes
anya: synths show no 5xxs, just latency; but higher p99s too
triage-bot: created INC-2026-052 - postdeploy synth latency elevation
sam: recommendation: pause the automated ramp and pin the /chat/complete route to previous variant v3.0.0 while we dig in
anya: +1 pause and pin
matt: I suspect the local_first hint is causing extra header fetches for multi-tenant headers, leading to KV pressure
lucy: sample pin call:
```
POST /admin/routing/pin
{"route":"/chat/complete","variant":"v3.0.0"}
```
sam: executed pin (action id 4591234672) -> /chat/complete -> v3.0.0 :white_check_mark:
deploy-bot: routing pin applied (actor: sam)
ops-bot: smoke-probe run (post-pin) -> p95=162ms p99=220ms status=ok
anya: nice, back near normal. leaving canary at 15% for 20m for stability window
matt: I'll instrument auth KV client with a small histogram to catch microbursts and add backpressure alert if miss rate >2% in 1m
lucy: adding follow-up ticket RFC-2026-99 to evaluate header prefetch and local cache warming for auth metadata
sam: note for changelog: temporarily pinned /chat/complete to v3.0.0 due to increased auth-KV miss rate when routing.hint_local_first enabled; continued analysis in RFC-2026-99
triage-bot: INC-2026-052 marked monitoring; awaiting stable window
anya: retrospective action: include a quick synthetic that exercises tenant-auth paths in preflight smoke for routing changes
matt: also suggest a tiny perf test in staging that toggles routing.hint_local_first under load
sam: if stable at 4591234780, resume manual ramp to 45% (sam to trigger)
lucy: will update release notes and ping platform owners about the RFC
anya: thanks team — keeping this thread open until canary finishes the window
triage-bot: locknote: keep incident open until 20m stable signal received
